title: ReturnOps AU F.01 wire contract 1.0.0-rc.3
description: Review-ready contract, not an implemented API or a replacement for runtime authorization and state guards. Validate a named $defs schema, never this permissive registry root.

RetrievalResult.description: C1-owned complete retrieval result for this case/input/corpus. The orchestrator preserves passages and conflict signals unchanged when handing it to C2; 100 is a technical capacity, not a retrieval target or evaluation-case quota.

RiskReviewRequest.description: Independent review input assembled by deterministic orchestration, not by trusting Assessment to reconstruct sources. retrieval_result must be the original accepted C1 result including conflicts; case/input/corpus bindings and citation-check coverage must match packet before invocation. Runtime hand-off checks are required beyond JSON Schema.

FounderDecisionRequest.description: Exactly one target: current proposal ID/version, processing_failure_id, or order_lookup_block_id. Both non-proposal targets permit MANUAL_HANDLING only when the current authoritative case is ESCALATED with no current proposal. They grant no approval or return/label dispatch. Verify current case/input/target, trusted Founder identity and expected case version at runtime. A stored decision retains its exact historical target; later input must not rewrite history. The record principal_id is server-derived, never client-supplied.

FounderDecisionRecord.description: Exactly one target: current proposal ID/version, processing_failure_id, or order_lookup_block_id. Both non-proposal targets permit MANUAL_HANDLING only when the current authoritative case is ESCALATED with no current proposal. They grant no approval or return/label dispatch. Verify current case/input/target, trusted Founder identity and expected case version at runtime. A stored decision retains its exact historical target; later input must not rewrite history. The record principal_id is server-derived, never client-supplied.

ProcessingFailure.description: Sanitised server-recorded technical processing failure, visible only to an authorised Founder. Business CONFLICT/AUTHORITY_DENIED from order lookup uses OrderLookupBlock instead. It is not a RiskOutcome or permission. Current case/input/failure binding must be checked at runtime.

CaseView.description: Founder-only authoritative read model. processing_failure and order_lookup_block are mutually exclusive current records, not history arrays. ESCALATED without a current proposal requires exactly one. OrderLookupBlock is pre-proposal only. The resolved target may remain visible through notification/manual completion; replacing it or adding input invalidates stale requests, while prior decisions and source records remain auditable. Never erase historical approvals or operations, including unknown effects, to satisfy this read shape; those records confer no new authority.

AnalyticsQuery.description: Optional case.created_at cohort bounds [created_from, created_before) and one current status at as_of. Omitted bounds are unbounded subject to snapshot time; omitted status includes all statuses. Both bounds, if present, must satisfy created_from < created_before; runtime comparison is required. Extra query names are rejected.

AnalyticsSnapshot.description: One authorised, as_of-consistent case cohort for every count and latency bucket. Echo the applied filters. Count each case once; latest applicable review of the current proposal only. Each case's current-input latest assessment episode occupies exactly one of measured, failed or unmeasured. Technical failure is distinct from a business ESCALATE result. Cross-field counts, timestamp ordering and percentile relationships need deterministic runtime validation.

unmeasured_count.description: Cases without a completed valid or failed measurement for the current input's latest assessment episode, including not-started, in-progress and missing telemetry. Never substitute zero latency.

OrderLookupBlock.description: Sanitised current pre-proposal order-lookup block persisted by Domain Service from an accepted OrderLookupResult. Only CONFLICT or AUTHORITY_DENIED; not a technical error, RiskReview, customer entitlement decision or execution permission. The source case/input/status/message must match; retain protected provenance in the audit trail. NOT_FOUND takes clarification; PROVIDER_FAILURE takes bounded technical recovery. Source conflicts belong to the packet/Risk path.
